description: Operon test: intergenic gaps and strand agreement around PP_3598, PP_2179 and PP_5298
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

rows = [
 # block, locus_tag, desc, start, end, strand
 ("PP_3598 region","PP_3594","ABC transporter permease",4083858,4084577,"+"),
 ("PP_3598 region","PP_3595","ABC transporter permease",4084574,4085284,"+"),
 ("PP_3598 region","PP_3596","FAD-binding oxidoreductase (amaD)",4085301,4086545,"+"),
 ("PP_3598 region","PP_3597","aa ABC transporter ATPase (artM)",4086568,4087350,"+"),
 ("PP_3598 region","PP_3598","gamma-Glu-GABA hydrolase family",4087776,4088585,"+"),
 ("PP_3598 region","PP_3599","5-dehydro-4-deoxyglucarate dehydratase",4088933,4089844,"+"),
 ("PP_3598 region","PP_3600","MFS transporter",4089949,4091313,"+"),
 ("PP_3598 region","PP_3601","galactarate dehydratase",4091391,4092944,"+"),
 ("PP_3598 region","PP_3602","aldehyde dehydrogenase NADP+",4093003,4094583,"+"),
 ("PP_2179 region","PP_2176","LysR regulator",2481445,2482338,"-"),
 ("PP_2179 region","PP_2177","HTH protein",2482552,2483106,"+"),
 ("PP_2179 region","PP_2178","glutamine synthetase (puuA-I)",2483134,2484480,"+"),
 ("PP_2179 region","PP_2179","spuA / gamma-Glu-GABA hydrolase",2484565,2485338,"+"),
 ("PP_2179 region","PP_2180","aminotransferase (spuC-I)",2485408,2486766,"+"),
 ("PP_2179 region","PP_2181","HTH protein",2486950,2487504,"+"),
 ("PP_2179 region","PP_2182","ProQ/FinO protein",2487628,2488143,"+"),
 ("PP_5298 region","PP_5295","YicC family protein",6042150,6043013,"+"),
 ("PP_5298 region","PP_5296","guanylate kinase",6043027,6043647,"+"),
 ("PP_5298 region","PP_5297","APC family permease",6043681,6045222,"-"),
 ("PP_5298 region","PP_5298","gamma-Glu-GABA hydrolase family",6045342,6046109,"-"),
 ("PP_5298 region","PP_5299","glutamine synthetase (puuA-II)",6046114,6047496,"-"),
 ("PP_5298 region","PP_5300","LysR regulator",6047702,6048574,"+"),
 ("PP_5298 region","PP_5301","RNA polymerase omega",6048815,6049078,"+"),
]
df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["block","locus_tag","desc","start","end","strand"])
out=[]
for b,g in df.groupby("block",sort=False):
    g=g.sort_values("start").reset_index(drop=True)
    g["gap_to_prev_bp"]=[np.nan]+[int(g.start[i]-g.end[i-1]-1) for i in range(1,len(g))]
    g["same_strand_as_prev"]=[None]+[bool(g.strand[i]==g.strand[i-1]) for i in range(1,len(g))]
    out.append(g)
df=pd.concat(out,ignore_index=True)
df.to_csv("operon_coordinates_KT2440_PuuD_regions.csv",index=False)

# gap context around each paralog
print("Intergenic gaps flanking each PuuD-family gene (bp):")
for lt in ["PP_3598","PP_2179","PP_5298"]:
    i=df.index[df.locus_tag==lt][0]
    up=df.loc[i,"gap_to_prev_bp"]; dn=df.loc[i+1,"gap_to_prev_bp"]
    print(f"  {lt}: upstream {up:.0f} bp (to {df.loc[i-1,'locus_tag']}), downstream {dn:.0f} bp (to {df.loc[i+1,'locus_tag']})")
med = df["gap_to_prev_bp"].dropna()
print(f"\nAll 20 intergenic gaps in the three regions: median {med.median():.0f} bp, IQR {med.quantile(.25):.0f}-{med.quantile(.75):.0f} bp, max {med.max():.0f} bp")
print("Rank of the PP_3598 flanking gaps among all 20:",
      sorted(med.values)[::-1].index(425.0)+1, "and", sorted(med.values)[::-1].index(347.0)+1, "largest (ties aside)")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(12,7.5))
cols={"gamma":"#c0392b","GS":"#2980b9","AT":"#27ae60","reg":"#7f8c8d","other":"#bdc3c7"}
def cat(d):
    if "hydrolase" in d or "spuA" in d: return "gamma"
    if "glutamine synthetase" in d: return "GS"
    if "aminotransferase" in d: return "AT"
    if "regulator" in d or "HTH" in d: return "reg"
    return "other"
for ax,(b,g) in zip(axes, df.groupby("block",sort=False)):
    x0=g.start.min()
    for _,r in g.iterrows():
        a,e=r.start-x0,r.end-x0
        if r.strand=="-": a,e=e,a
        ax.arrow(a,0,e-a,0,head_width=0.32,head_length=70,length_includes_head=True,
                 fc=cols[cat(r.desc)],ec="k",lw=0.5)
        ax.text((r.start+r.end)/2-x0,0.45,r.locus_tag.replace("PP_",""),ha="center",fontsize=7.5,rotation=0)
    gg=g.reset_index(drop=True)
    for i in range(1,len(gg)):
        gap=gg.gap_to_prev_bp[i]
        if gap>150:
            ax.text((gg.end[i-1]+gg.start[i])/2-x0,-0.55,f"{gap:.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#c0392b",fontweight="bold")
        else:
            ax.text((gg.end[i-1]+gg.start[i])/2-x0,-0.55,f"{gap:.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#555")
    ax.set_ylim(-1.1,1.0); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_title(b,fontsize=10,loc="left")
    ax.set_xlabel("bp from first gene in region",fontsize=8)
for k,lab in [("gamma","PuuD/SpuA family hydrolase"),("GS","glutamine synthetase (PuuA-like)"),
              ("AT","aminotransferase"),("reg","transcriptional regulator"),("other","other")]:
    axes[0].plot([],[],marker="s",ls="",color=cols[k],label=lab)
axes[0].legend(fontsize=7.5,ncol=5,loc="upper center",bbox_to_anchor=(0.5,1.55),frameon=False)
fig.suptitle("Genomic context of the three closest PuuD-family paralogs in P. putida KT2440\n"
             "numbers are intergenic gaps in bp; red marks gaps > 150 bp",fontsize=10,y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
